# Seedreign

> A free territory conquest .io strategy game for browser and phone. One
> procedurally generated world is sown every dawn, the same seed for every
> player, and it collapses at nightfall. Play asynchronously in 7 to 25
> minutes, then share a spoiler free emoji grid of your run.

Seedreign is mobile first, free to play, and monetised only through cosmetics
and ads. It is never pay to win: the competitive surfaces are skill levelled,
and the daily draft is dealt by the seed rather than from a player's
collection.

## How a run works

- One world per day, generated from a single integer seed, identical for
  everyone.
- Expand your colour across the map. A slider splits your army between attack
  and defence, and population grows with the territory you hold.
- The world reacts every few minutes with events called World Pulses: floods,
  quakes, raids, vaults opening.
- Every run ends in the Collapse, a shrinking play area that forces the final
  confrontation.
- The daily victory condition rotates: conquest, domination, relic hunt, blitz,
  last banner, wonders, asymmetric goals.
